index.summary: The Jackson City Council approved the FY2027 budget on a 5-1 vote after adding about $600,000 for firefighter personnel by shifting money from a Grand Gulf emergency planning fund through JPD capital outlay. The council also passed a $1,001,962.88 C Spire contract for IT infrastructure and network modernization, and approved an MOU with ATF for a gun enforcement task force. A proposed ordinance to rename Wood Street to Dr. Roderick Demond Little Drive was amended to honorary status and then removed from the agenda after debate. The council discussed the Tasia Fortune hanging investigation, with the police chief saying the case is being investigated as a homicide and the medical examiner has not yet ruled. Public commenters raised concerns about JTRAN service, infrastructure, crime, and the condition of city streets.
